name: Dragon Gate
note: Chinatown's gate across Grant Avenue just north of Bush (1970). At OSM's node n65328703 (man_made=ceremonial_gate), 13 m north of the Grant/Bush junction node. Grant's bearing -9 deg measured in game (streetBearing).

name: Pier 39 sea lions
note: The K-Dock floats in Pier 39's west marina, given over to sea lions since 1990.

name: Bison Paddock
note: Golden Gate Park's bison, since 1891: the meadow south of JFK Drive between Spreckels Lake and the Chain of Lakes. Placed on the open meadow inside OSM's paddock (way/161707029), measured from above.

name: Lands End Labyrinth
note: Eduardo Aguilera's stone labyrinth (2004) on the Eagle Point promontory.

name: Wave Organ
note: Tip of the Marina jetty (1986): salvaged cemetery stone terraces and the organ's pipes.

name: Portals of the Past
note: Lloyd Lake, Golden Gate Park: the Towne house's marble portico (1909 here). OSM maps it as a building; was a solid box.

name: The Parapet, Sutro Heights
note: OSM viewpoint node n1709352211; the terrace faces the ocean (west), steps from the garden (east).

note: The Powell-Hyde line's turntable at Hyde and Beach, by Aquatic Park (OSM way/197979144); the track stub runs south up Hyde.

name: Taylor and Bay Turntable
note: The Powell-Mason line's turntable at Taylor and Bay (OSM way/667569434); the track stub runs south up Taylor.

name: Hyde Street cable car turnaround
note: Brick-paved plaza round the Hyde Street turntable at Beach, where the bake drew Victorian Park's lawn (backlog, 2026-10-03).

name: 16th Avenue Tiled Steps
note: Moraga Street, 15th to 16th Avenue; OSM steps ways w39333460 et al. Draped; +x uphill (east), risers face west.

name: Hidden Garden Steps
note: 16th Avenue, Kirkham to Lawton (OSM way/47174862, artwork_type=mosaic). Low at the north end (22 m), high at the south (48 m); +x uphill, turned 78 deg.

name: Hyde Street cable car approach
note: Brick street along the turnaround track (OSM way/680987101) from the turntable 60 m (stopping at the corner, off the asphalt) toward Hyde Street; was lawn.

name: Civic Center Plaza
note: The plaza in front of City Hall: promenade, Avenue of Flags (OSM poles), clipped planes, garage vent stacks, the Helen Diller playgrounds (OSM rects) from the playground kit; café and half-courts by eye.

name: The Golden Fire Hydrant
note: OSM node 3989015890. The hydrant that kept the water running in 1906 and saved the Mission; repainted gold every April 18th.

name: Seward Street Slides
note: In Seward Mini Park (way/138662530), beside the Acme Alley steps; down the hill from the Corwin end (24.6 m in game) toward Seward Street (4 m). Not in OSM; placed along the park's axis.

name: 24th St Mission BART Plaza (south-west)
note: bart-plazas.ts: the round red-brick plaza and its open well of stairs (owner's aerial); claims OSM subway_entrance n318297867.

name: 24th St Mission BART Plaza (north-east)
note: bart-plazas.ts: the oblong sunken stair on the north-east corner; claims n318297918 and n4081470905.

name: Grace Cathedral Labyrinth (outdoor)
note: park-sights.ts: the terrazzo eleven-circuit labyrinth on the cathedral plaza, at OSM n9010894444.

name: The Wiggle (green-backed sharrows)
note: wiggle.ts: the flat bike route from Duboce & Church to Scott & Fell; the footprint is the Steiner & Waller crossing alone.

name: Randall Museum
note: 1951, William Merchant: streamlined cream masonry and concrete, an entry loggia between two ramps (Wikipedia, randallmuseum.org); the bake's grey. Museums census 2026-10-04. Modelled 2026-10-06 from the owner's photograph (oddities.ts).

name: Bernal Hill Labyrinth

name: Levi's Plaza Fountain
note: fountains.ts: Halprin 1982, the hard plaza's pool, granite weirs and stepped pyramid with its jet (Commons 'Levi's Plaza Park (hard, fountain pano).jpg'). Fountain census 2026-10-05; the plaza was bare paving. baseY: the plaza's paving (-80.15 to -80.35, picked) stood over the pool from the footprint's lowest ground.

name: Levi's Plaza buildings
note: Levi's Plaza (HOK, 1982): terraced office blocks of red-brown brick with long dark ribbon windows round the two plazas (Mapillary on Battery and Filbert, 2026-10-05). Were beige bauhaus and brown-roofed blocks.

name: Aurora (Ruth Asawa)
note: fountains.ts: Asawa 1986, a folded stainless-steel ring on its edge in a blue-tiled basin, framing the Bay Bridge (Commons 'Aurora sculpture Asawa.jpg'). Fountain census 2026-10-05; was not drawn.
